name: Community bank that keeps the loan

reason.label: Easy to qualify for
reason.note: The OCC's Comptroller's Handbook on Mortgage Banking states that banks have traditionally originated residential mortgage loans to hold in their own portfolios, and it separately instructs examiners to review the extent to which a bank's underwriting standards for loans it sells differ from its standards for loans it keeps in portfolio, noting that conforming loans sold to Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac must comply with those agencies' loan size limits, terms and underwriting guidelines while a bank retaining a loan sets its own standard. A portfolio lender is not guaranteed to approve a borrower an automated underwriting system would decline, but its underwriting is not bound to agency guidelines the way a loan built for sale is, which is why this route exists for borrowers who do not fit a standard file.

reason.label: Easy to qualify for
reason.note: The CFPB states plainly that "a broker does not lend money" and that a borrower can use a broker to find different lenders or mortgage loans. Because a broker submits an application to more than one wholesale lender rather than to just one, a borrower whose file does not fit one lender's guidelines can still be placed with another lender through the same broker relationship, which is the structural reason this route can reach borrowers a single retail lender would turn away.

reason.label: Manufacturer guarantee length
reason.note: Under EU Ecodesign Regulation 2019/2023, Annex II, manufacturers must make key spare parts, including the motor, drum, pumps, heating elements and circuit boards, available to professional repairers for 10 years after the last unit of a model is placed on the market, deliver ordered parts within 15 working days, and give professional repairers access to repair and diagnostic information from two years after a model's market placement.

name: Secondhand and giveaway networks
brand: not a purchase, or a small one

reason.label: Energy and water use per wash
reason.note: The European Environment Agency frames reuse and repair as ways to 'reduce the demand for new products', and states that premature disposal across the EU causes an estimated 261 million tonnes of CO2-equivalent emissions, consumes 30 million tonnes of resources and generates 35 million tonnes of waste each year, impacts that keeping a machine in use through resale or reuse avoids.

name: Self-service launderette
brand: not a purchase, pay per wash

reason.label: Ease of access without buying new
reason.note: NALI, the UK trade association for self-service launderettes, says they serve 'students, those in rented accommodation with no machine provided, people with little time or inclination to launder at home and the elderly or disabled who are unable to manage it', and are 'a welcome saviour when the domestic machine breaks down', without the user buying, installing or maintaining any equipment.
